technique_name: Compare and contrast the advantages of both convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and recurrent neural networks (RNNs).
description: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are well-suited for tasks involving image recognition and classification, due to their ability to detect patterns in images. They are composed of multiple layers which allow them to extract features from different levels of the image and create a hierarchical representation.
